description: Header file defining data structures, constants, and function prototypes for geohash encoding, decoding, and neighbor calculations in a geospatial library.

methods.name: geohashGetCoordRange
methods.description: Retrieves the coordinate ranges for longitude and latitude.

methods.name: geohashEncode
methods.description: Encodes longitude and latitude into a geohash with specified step.

methods.name: geohashEncodeType
methods.description: Encodes coordinates into a geohash of a specific type.

methods.name: geohashEncodeWGS84
methods.description: Encodes WGS84 coordinates into a geohash.

methods.name: geohashDecode
methods.description: Decodes a geohash into geographic area bounds.

methods.name: geohashDecodeType
methods.description: Decodes a geohash of a specific type into geographic area bounds.

methods.name: geohashDecodeWGS84
methods.description: Decodes a WGS84 geohash into geographic area bounds.

methods.name: geohashDecodeAreaToLongLat
methods.description: Converts a geohash area to longitude and latitude coordinates.

methods.name: geohashDecodeToLongLatType
methods.description: Converts a geohash of a specific type to longitude and latitude.

methods.name: geohashDecodeToLongLatWGS84
methods.description: Converts a WGS84 geohash to longitude and latitude.

methods.name: geohashDecodeToLongLatMercator
methods.description: Converts a geohash to Mercator projection coordinates.
